note: Mask Field applies a jQuery-Mask input mask two ways: (1) per-field-widget settings stored as third_party_settings.mask on a widget component in an entity_form_display (supported widgets string_textfield and telephone_default, declared in mask.mask_field_widgets.yml, a YAML mask_field_widget plugin type); options value/reverse/clearifnotmatch/selectonfocus. (2) a Form API #mask property on textfield/tel elements (hook_element_info_alter + ElementHelper). The mask 'alphabet' is the mask.settings 'translation' table (shipped locked symbols 0/9/#=digit, A=letter-or-number, S=letter) plus use_cdn/plugin_path; configure route mask.settings at admin/config/content/mask, permission 'administer mask module'. Masking is client-side only. Field-based cases use a namespaced content type mask_ct (this minimal site has no 'article' type). Introspection reads a known field mask value and a custom translation symbol; execution sets a field's mask value and adds a custom pattern symbol to mask.settings.

evals.prompt: On Drupal 11 with the mask module, how do I make a text field only accept a phone-number format like (00) 0000-0000, and where is that mask stored? Which field widgets support this out of the box?
evals.expected_output: On the bundle's Manage form display, open the Text field (string_textfield) or Telephone (telephone_default) widget cog and enter the Mask in 'Mask settings'. It is stored as third_party_settings.mask (value/reverse/clearifnotmatch/selectonfocus) on that field's component in core.entity_form_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode>.

evals.prompt: I am building a custom Drupal form and want to mask an input without configuring a field. What Form API property does the mask module add, and which element types support it?
evals.expected_output: Set the '#mask' render property (['value' => '(00) 0000-0000', ...]) on a 'textfield' or 'tel' element. hook_element_info_alter() / ElementHelper add #mask to those types and render data-mask-* attributes that js/mask.js applies.

evals.prompt: The mask module only offers its 'Mask settings' on a couple of field widgets. Which widgets does it support by default, and how can my own module make masking available on a different widget?
evals.expected_output: Out of the box it supports string_textfield and telephone_default (mask.mask_field_widgets.yml). To add another widget, ship a <module>.mask_field_widgets.yml file listing that widget's plugin id (YAML mask_field_widget plugin type, plugin.manager.mask_field_widget).

evals.prompt: On this site, the content type 'mask_ct' has a text field field_mask_known whose widget has a Mask configured with the mask module. Inspect the live default form display and tell me the exact mask string that is configured.
evals.expected_output: (00) 0000-0000 - in core.entity_form_display.node.mask_ct.default the field_mask_known (string_textfield) component has third_party_settings.mask.value = '(00) 0000-0000'.

evals.prompt: Someone added a custom mask pattern symbol to this site's Mask Field settings. Inspect the live mask configuration and tell me which symbol character was added and the regular-expression pattern it maps to.
evals.expected_output: The symbol 'Z' was added with pattern '[a-z]' (a lowercase letter): mask.settings translation now has a Z entry alongside the shipped locked symbols 0/9/#/A/S.

evals.prompt: On this site, the content type 'mask_ct' has a text field field_mask_task using the Text field (string_textfield) widget. Using the mask module, configure the default form display so this field's widget applies the input mask 00/00/0000 (a dd/mm/yyyy date). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.mask_ct.default the field_mask_task component carries third_party_settings.mask.value = '00/00/0000' (set via the Mask settings on Manage form display, or by editing the component's third_party_settings and saving).

evals.prompt: Using the mask module's settings, add a new custom mask pattern symbol 'Q' that matches a single uppercase letter (regex [A-Z]) to this site, so it can be used inside field masks. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: mask.settings 'translation' gains a 'Q' entry with pattern '[A-Z]' (added via the Patterns table on admin/config/content/mask, or by editing the mask.settings translation config).
